messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT DETECTED — Elevated 5xx and timeouts for Private VPC cross-region traffic (ILB paths). Source: GCP load balancer control plane API returning 503/429 during config propagation. Paging on-call SRE @mike.

mike: On it. Starting with LB health + control plane API logs. Can folks drop any customer reports here?

elaine: Seeing multiple customer threads in support: inference requests from EU->US private VPC timing out. Customer impact appears intermittent but widespread for cross-region routes.

jordan: I can see the ILB proxies in us-central1 returning repeated "backend not available" / 502s in the proxy logs. Trace looks like config push failures: control-plane ack not received.

mike: Confirmed via gcloud: controlplane API for backendService updates returning 503s and 429s for several minutes. Connectivity to backends themselves is fine. Likely GCP control-plane throttling / partial outage affecting config propagation for ILBs. Opening case with GCP now.

kacie: I'll prepare a customer notification draft. Which customers are seeing highest error rates?

elaine: Currently hit list from support: AcmeHealth, FinBot, DocFlow. All on Private VPCs with cross-region failover enabled.

jordan: Prioritizing mitigation: recommend temporary routing policy to prefer same-region endpoints (avoid cross-region fanout) until GCP control plane stabilizes. Will push runtime override in Redwood Console to pin traffic.

mike: Agreed. Applying traffic override to reduce ILB config churn. Rolling change now (small batches).

jordan: Patch command I'm using (runbook snippet):
```
# apply region-prefer policy to vpc-route set
redwoodctl routes update --vpc my-cust-vpc --policy region_prefer --target-region eu-west1
```

support-bot: Created incident ticket RED-INC-202603, added incident label `gcp-networking`, paged out to ops-lead and support.

ops-lead: GCP case opened: 987654321. GCP support: "We are seeing control plane throttling impacting ILB config pushes in multiple regions, engineers investigating." We're asking for ETA and scope.

kacie: Customer comms sent to impacted accounts with initial detail and that we're applying a mitigation to reduce cross-region routing. Will update when monitoring shows stabilizing.

mike: Mitigation applied to 3 large VPCs. Observing immediate reduction in 5xx on those routes from ~18% -> ~3% within 6 minutes. Rolling to remaining affected VPCs.

jordan: Note: this is a safety-first mitigation — it increases latency for some flows (no cross-region failover) but reduces customer errors. Documented in the incident runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/networking/gcp-ilb-controlplane.md

oncall-sre: Acknowledged handoff request. I'll monitor for the next 3 hours and be ready to revert the routing override once GCP confirms fix. Please leave any open actions.

mike: Current status: errors down to 2.1% and falling, control plane errors persist sporadically. GCP provided engineers are investigating root cause. No data plane failure observed.

elaine: CS will continue to update impacted customers. Asking product to queue an SLA-impact calc once we have final duration.

ops-lead: Action items logged: 1) Keep routing override until GCP confirms fix. 2) Collect per-customer error windows + request counts. 3) Prepare postmortem (networking + oncall). 4) Review fallback policies to reduce manual intervention in future.

support-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, mitigation=region_prefer_policy, gcp_case=987654321. Tagging networking, eng-runtime, support.

mike: Handing off to @oncall-sre for watch and follow-up. I'll sync with jordan overnight on cleanup and rollback plan.

incident-bot: Please file a postmortem within 72 hours and include timelines, customer impact, and mitigation decisions. Tag: #postmortems, owners: mike, jordan, ops-lead.

elaine: Thanks everyone. Oncall handoff complete. Leaving a short runbook note in the incident ticket for whoever takes over. :white_check_mark:
